method.description: One of24 letter-marked stones/potsherds selected without looking from jug/box/bag; shake-out variant described historically. Software only records one user-declared mark; no physical performance or multiple-draw/replacement convention.

normalization: ASCII trim then NFC only; no NFKC/confusable folding. ASCII Latin names/gao-IDs lowercase. Exact verified Greek uppercase/lowercase pairs; final sigmaς is an explicitly named editorial orthographic alias for Sigma, not a25th lot. Chi spelling supported by same-author pronunciation guide; oracle source display Khi retained.
origin_policy: User-reported observation provenance only. Software does not verify a physical blind draw, infer a mark from a question, or certify randomness.
